description: This file contains extension methods for registering and configuring grain services within the Orleans runtime, specifically for use with the Silo builder pattern. It includes methods for adding grain services, creating grain service instances, and managing service collection dependencies.

classes.name: GrainServicesSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to facilitate the registration and setup of grain services within an Orleans silo environment.

methods.name: AddGrainService<T>(this ISiloBuilder builder)
methods.description: Registers a grain service implementation type with the silo builder, enabling it to be started with the silo.

methods.name: GrainServiceFactory(Type serviceType, IServiceProvider services)
methods.description: Creates an instance of a grain service, ensuring it implements IGrainService and associating it with a grain ID.

methods.name: AddGrainService<T>(this IServiceCollection services)
methods.description: Adds a grain service of specified type T to the service collection.

methods.name: AddGrainService(IServiceCollection services, Type grainServiceType)
methods.description: Adds a grain service of a given type to the service collection as a singleton.
